answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 8782 Country: India Title: Can a person have sex (intercourse) with his wife for more than one time WITHOUT taking bath (Ghusul) on the same night? Question: Assalamwalaikum, Q) Can a person have sex (intercourse) with his wife for more than one time WITHOUT taking bath (Ghusul) on the same night? Answer ID: 8782 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1085/1085=M/1429) He can do so, but it is better to have wudhu or ghusl between two intercourses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
